pages.quiz:
GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Action of wind and water in arid areas is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Action of wind and water in arid areas.
   B. Treat Action of wind and water in arid areas as rumours only.
   C. Say Action of wind and water in arid areas never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Action of wind and water in arid areas with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

3. Which statement about Underground Water is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Underground Water.
   B. Say Underground Water never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Underground Water with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Underground Water as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   C. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

6. Which statement about Fishing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Fishing never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing.
   C. Explain Fishing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Fishing as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Trade.
   B. Say Trade never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Trade as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

10. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   C. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.

11. Which statement about Lakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Lakes never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Lakes.
   C. Explain Lakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Lakes as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Glaciation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Glaciation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Glaciation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Glaciation as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Glaciation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Elementary Surveying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Action of wind and water in arid areas and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Geographic Information Systems; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
